messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up 1: we need a quick customer note for 6 high-touch accounts impacted by this morning's embeddings ingest slowdown. Draft below for edits. @kevin_success_mgr @liz_product @jordan_se

kevin_success_mgr: Add clear billing credit line and how it appears on invoices. :money_with_wings:

liz_product: Offer a free 30-min enablement session in the note to lower churn risk. Keep it short. :white_check_mark:

jordan_se: Mitigation timeline: injected routing fallback to warm dedicated pools at 12:32 UTC which restored throughput. Expect p99 latency up ~15-20% for some requests. We're backfilling queued ingests now.

jordan_se: Command used for ops reference:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api/tenants/enable-fallback -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant_id":"<TENANT>","fallback":"dedicated_pool"}'
```

nick_onboarding: I'll run scheduling for enablement: propose Tue 09:00-11:00 PT and Wed 13:00-15:00 PT slots. I'll DM each contact after the email.

maria_cs: Draft email to customers:
"Hi <CustomerName>,

We9re writing to update you about a short degradation in embeddings ingestion that began at ~12:10 UTC today. To restore throughput we temporarily routed affected tenants to a warm dedicated pool; this resolved the backlog but may cause slightly higher latency on some requests.

What we9re doing:
- Applied regional routing fallback to dedicated capacity (completed).
- Running targeted retries/backfill to clear queued items (in progress).
- Investigating the root cause; we will provide an RCA within 72 hours.

Billing: We will apply a one-time billing credit to offset measurable impact during the affected period; your CS rep will follow up with details.

Offer: Complimentary 30-minute enablement session to review ingest best practices and workload tuning. Book here: <calendar-link>.

If you need immediate help, reply to this email or open a support ticket and we will prioritize.

Thanks,
The Redwood Customer Success Team"

kevin_success_mgr: Approved. Wording looks good.

liz_product: Add quick FAQ line: "Will data residency change? No  routing remains inside your configured region."

ops_lead: Confirmed fallback is safe for these tenants; KV cache compatibility validated, no data loss.

srebot: Incident 1769980000  Embedded ingestion throughput degraded. Mitigation: regional fallback active. Status: monitoring.

maria_cs: Sending now from cs@redwood. Tasks:
- maria_cs: send emails (now)
- nick_onboarding: schedule enablement + follow-ups
- jordan_se/ops_lead: continue RCA and timeline
- liz_product: create 3-question feedback form
- kevin_success_mgr: coordinate billing credit with finance

maria_cs: Will post updates when customers respond. :rocket:
